reason: Classified as an external service integration plugin because it explicitly adds Tencent CodeBuddy to DeepSeek Harness as a native provider, with OAuth login, credential refresh, and model synchronization to expose and use CodeBuddy chat models inside the host platform.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，可接入腾讯 CodeBuddy 服务，在模型列表中提供可用模型，并支持浏览器 OAuth 登录、凭据续期和模型同步。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that connects to Tencent CodeBuddy, exposing its models in the host and supporting browser OAuth login, credential refresh, and model synchronization.

capabilities: Browser-based OAuth login and token handling for CodeBuddy access
Automatic token refresh logic on startup and periodic refresh cycles
Native LLM adapter wiring for streaming chat requests to an external model API
Model metadata synchronization from external service config endpoint

reasons.code: README describes browser OAuth login, token renewal behavior, and credential usage for CodeBuddy access.
README states a native ctx.llm adapter and model-list sync are used to integrate CodeBuddy chat and configuration endpoints.
Package metadata defines a DSH plugin bundle and a login CLI binary, confirming external-service integration plus terminal entrypoint.
Repository metadata and topic tags identify the project as a DSH plugin targeting CodeBuddy/DeepSeek Harness integration.
